objective.statement: Capture temporary PAIR multi-pool relative-price discrepancies with one atomic USDG round trip while maximizing absolute net USDG profit inside explicit capital and gas bounds.

race_thesis.reward_source: a temporary executable relative-price discrepancy between two PAIR V4 quote pools after both USDG anchor routes, AMM fees, price impact and gas

sequencing_rule.reason: Robinhood Chain public documentation and the current repository do not provide canonical sequencer-arrival evidence for competing arbitrage transactions

race_thesis.earliest_public_signal: a fixed-block executable quote change or Swap touching an admitted V3 or PAIR V4 leg
race_thesis.earliest_inferable_signal: external quote-asset movement may predict stale PAIR holders, but it cannot prove executable on-chain state
race_thesis.earliest_safe_action: precompute bounded typed routes; sign only after current-block executor simulation, exact gas estimation, nonce, balance and deadline checks
invalidating_evidence: PAIR pool updates are synchronized closely enough that four-leg net-positive states do not persist
the actual sequencer rule makes public-RPC reaction consistently too late
exact executor gas removes the positive screens across a representative opportunity census

ladder.causal_claim: all four quote legs and the native mark at one canonical block identify a candidate relative-price discrepancy
the exact typed payload is currently executable and meets the configured net floor

fallbacks: NO_SHOT when the board is stale, no candidate simulates, or exact gas removes the edge
signal_strategy.false_positive_policy: reject before signing; a board proxy can never independently authorize execution
signal_strategy.false_negative_audit: compare all fresh typed screened candidates with exact-preflight outcomes and retain rejected reasons

competition.competitor_model: UNKNOWN: an included arbitrage changes the shared pools and can consume some or all of the edge, but no canonical competitor cohort is measured yet
ordering_evidence: UNKNOWN: provider acceptance and gas price do not prove sequencer arrival order

sample_policy.insufficient_behavior: keep the bounded guarded policy and report intervals without claiming opportunity frequency or win probability

opportunity_census.source: complete PAIR first-party catalog plus newest-token reconciliation and persistent round-robin quote coverage
opportunity_census.completeness_watermark: catalog completeness and fresh quote coverage are separate snapshot fields; full exact-preflight coverage is not yet claimed

learning.model_versioning: APPEND_ONLY by candidateHash, executionKey, planHash and signed transaction hash

opportunity.dedupe_key: opportunity_id; candidate_hash remains the immutable payload fingerprint

timing.deadline_behavior: do not sign after the candidate or contract boundary; rerun discovery as a new opportunity revision

profile.protocol: PAIR V4 multi-pool plus canonical V3 anchors

correctness_invariants.condition: chain, executor build, PAIR hook, pool fee and spacing, V3 factory pools, fee allowlist, WETH bridge and route endpoints all match
correctness_invariants.risk_reduced: wrong-chain, arbitrary-call, forged-callback and wrong-pool execution
correctness_invariants.false_block_cost: one potentially valid route is rejected

latency_estimate.reason: provider-specific p95 for the combined identity readback is not yet recorded

voi_estimate.expected_loss_reduction: up to the bounded 100 USDG principal plus gas

correctness_invariants.condition: shared wallet lock is held, no unresolved mutation exists, latest nonce equals pending nonce and principal and ETH reserve are sufficient
correctness_invariants.risk_reduced: duplicate nonce, ambiguous replacement and capital oversubscription
correctness_invariants.false_block_cost: the opportunity may expire while the wallet lane is unavailable

latency_estimate.reason: live generic wallet-lane timing has not been measured

voi_estimate.expected_loss_reduction: prevents a second signed intent while canonical effect is UNKNOWN

correctness_invariants.condition: an unexpired arm matches chain, wallet, executor, source and runtime hashes and remains below principal, exact-preflight, signed-attempt, confirmed-execution and failed-gas budgets at the final signing boundary
correctness_invariants.risk_reduced: unbounded key authority, configuration drift, duplicate signer generations and paid-RPC exhaustion
correctness_invariants.false_block_cost: a valid opportunity is skipped until a fresh explicit arm is issued

latency_estimate.reason: local file checks are implemented but signing-host p95 is not yet recorded

voi_estimate.expected_loss_reduction: bounds every autonomous economic and infrastructure spend dimension
voi_estimate.basis: deployment-bound arm plus independent durable usage counters

correctness_invariants.condition: current-block GenericAtomicArb simulation succeeds and exact gas supports both the on-chain gross floor and configured net floor
correctness_invariants.risk_reduced: stale screen, intermediate inventory and predictable negative-net execution
correctness_invariants.false_block_cost: a profitable transaction may be missed when RPC state is delayed

latency_estimate.reason: only one historical fork route has exact gas evidence

voi_estimate.expected_loss_reduction: rejects any route that cannot atomically return protected USDG profit

adaptive_gates.condition: screen the adaptive amount grid broadly; manual preflight evaluates at most six candidates while the autonomous watcher escalates only one newly eligible opportunity
adaptive_gates.risk_reduced: RPC exhaustion and opportunity expiry from an unbounded exact sweep
adaptive_gates.false_block_cost: a lower-ranked proxy candidate may have the best exact net profit

latency_estimate.reason: exact-preflight latency distribution has not been sampled on the signing host

voi_estimate.reason: ranking regret between proxy and exact gas lacks a representative sample

adaptive_gates.fallback: evaluate candidates in proxy-net order and stop at the configured bound

soft_checks.condition: external stock, AI or meme movement is available without delaying current-chain validation
soft_checks.risk_reduced: weakens discovery latency for stale-holder behavior
soft_checks.false_block_cost: unacceptable because external category data is optional

latency_estimate.reason: no external predictor is wired into this version

min_out.rationale: intermediate leg bounds are replaced by one atomic final USDG gross-profit floor; any insufficient cycle reverts

authorization.scope_binding: the arm binds wallet, executor, source/runtime hashes, principal and spend budgets; each plan additionally binds candidate, nonce, routeHash, amount and economic envelope
authorization.expiry_policy: the arm has an absolute expiry and every transaction has a separately persisted short contract deadline
authorization.evidence_record: append-only arm, exact-preflight attempt, mutation intent, plan, exact raw hash, receipt and effect records

execution.nonce_policy: one shared wallet lane; persist exact raw before first broadcast
execution.broadcast_policy: same raw transaction only after two-reader NOT_OBSERVED reconciliation

recovery.restart_policy: reconcile the shared wallet lane before any discovery candidate can become a new signed intent
recovery.unresolved_transaction_fallback: pause every signer sharing the wallet

exit.policy: successful execution is atomically flat in intermediate assets; explicit operator-only USDG withdrawal exits the executor float
exit.sell_failure_fallback: a failed atomic route reverts intermediate state; a failed withdrawal remains in the executor and requires reconciliation

limitations: generic-v2 signing-host latency and sequencer arrival remain unmeasured
PAIR first-party multi-pool catalog only; fresh exact coverage remains rolling rather than simultaneous
current generic mainnet deployment identity cannot be verified because no generic executor is deployed
board gas is a proxy until exact executor preflight
one selected real route was validated on a local historical mainnet fork; no current deployed generic executor exists
typed PAIR route only; no arbitrary target or calldata adapter
generic-v2 mainnet signing has not been invoked or receipt-verified
generic-v2 mainnet broadcast has not been invoked or receipt-verified
generic-v2 UNKNOWN recovery has not been exercised against a mainnet transaction
generic-v2 mainnet withdrawal has not been invoked
deterministic mocks and one historical mainnet-fork candidate; no opportunity-frequency sample
